texto: Light travels in a straight line. Light leaves the flashlight and travels in a straight line, like an arrow. That is why the rays look straight.
Your mission. Drag the flashlight up and down and watch the rays.

Objects block light and make a shadow. When an object is in the way, light cannot pass and a dark area is left behind it: the shadow. If you bring the object closer to the flashlight, the shadow gets bigger.
Your mission. Drag the object close to and far from the flashlight and watch the shadow change.
Transparent, translucent and opaque. Some materials let all the light through: they are transparent. Others let a little through: they are translucent. And others let none through: they are opaque.
Your mission. Try the glass, the wax paper and the wood.
